description: This file defines the class NullAttributes which implements the Attributes interface, representing a JSON null value for attributes within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. It provides methods for handling JSON attribute data, specifically representing the null state with appropriate behavior and exceptions.

classes.description: A class implementing Attributes to represent a JSON null value, providing behavior for interacting with JSON data in a null state.
